scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic proof supplied with an independent finite algebraic checker; finite checks are not used as an infinite proof. Published literature is compared at statement level, with Whittle 1960 not fully accessible. No independent audit or definitive publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to independent identically distributed real symmetric three-point coordinates with variance one, t>=1, and the L2-to-L6 embedding. No assertion for inhomogeneous, complex, or dependent variables, or other exponents.
title: Sharp sixth-moment staircase for sparse symmetric three-point first chaos
